about.title: Two decades of building in Kuwait
about.body: Maram Group began with a single residential block in Salmiya and grew into one of Kuwait's steady development houses. We acquire carefully, design with architects we trust, and hand over on schedule. Every project is held to the same standard: durable materials, honest layouts, and locations that keep their value.

projects.heading: Our Latest Launches
projects.subheading: A portfolio shaped by location, craft and long-term value.
projects.pageSubheading: Every address we develop is chosen for its long-term value — residential, coastal and commercial across Kuwait.

nayef-al-masma.title: Nayef Al-Masma
nayef-al-masma.shortDescription: A modern private villa showcasing premium construction and refined architectural details.
nayef-al-masma.longDescription: Nayef Al-Masma is a contemporary private villa in Kuwait, designed with attention to detail and constructed using the finest materials. The residence features spacious interiors, a private garden, and modern amenities that cater to luxury family living.

maryam-al-shamali.title: Maryam Al-Shamali
maryam-al-shamali.shortDescription: Contemporary exterior design featuring clean lines and sophisticated modern aesthetics.
maryam-al-shamali.longDescription: This project showcases our expertise in modern exterior design. The facade combines contemporary architectural principles with functional elegance, creating a striking visual presence while maintaining timeless appeal.

reception-living-design-28.title: Reception & Living - Design 28
reception-living-design-28.shortDescription: An elegant interior design featuring sophisticated furnishings and premium finishes.
reception-living-design-28.longDescription: Design 28 transforms a living and reception space into a sophisticated environment using carefully selected materials, custom furniture, and an expertly curated lighting scheme. The design balances comfort with visual elegance.

salmiya-heights.title: Salmiya Heights
salmiya-heights.shortDescription: Forty-two residences overlooking the Gulf, finished in warm stone and bronze detailing.
salmiya-heights.longDescription: Salmiya Heights is a twelve-floor residential tower offering forty-two curated residences with unobstructed views of the Arabian Gulf. Each apartment is finished in warm limestone, brushed bronze hardware and floor-to-ceiling glazing. Residents enjoy a rooftop terrace, concierge service and direct access to the Salmiya waterfront promenade.

bnaider-villas.title: Bnaider Coastal Villas
bnaider-villas.shortDescription: Private seaside villas with terraced gardens, designed for slow weekends by the water.
bnaider-villas.longDescription: Twelve private villas set along the Bnaider coastline, each with a terraced garden that steps down to a private beach. The architecture draws on the vernacular of Kuwaiti coastal living — shaded arcades, deep overhangs and open-plan interiors that bring the sea inside. A community pool and landscaped pathway connect all twelve homes.

sharq-business-house.title: Sharq Business House
sharq-business-house.shortDescription: Grade-A offices and retail at the centre of the capital's business district.
sharq-business-house.longDescription: An eighteen-floor commercial address in the heart of Sharq, Kuwait City's primary business corridor. The ground floor hosts curated retail and a coffee destination; upper floors offer Grade-A office suites with flexible plate configurations. The building achieves LEED Silver certification and offers valet parking, meeting suites and 24/7 security.

our-story.title: Built from a single block in Salmiya
our-story.body: Maram Group was founded in 2005 with a single residential building in Salmiya and a straightforward conviction: Kuwait deserved more considered development. In the years that followed, we grew carefully — acquiring sites we believed in, working with architects we trusted, and handing over on schedule. That discipline compounded into a portfolio of residential towers, coastal villas and commercial addresses that have held their value and their residents' trust across two decades.

our-approach.title: Design-led. Delivery-disciplined.
our-approach.body: Every project begins with the same question: what would make someone choose to live or work here in twenty years? We start with location — not just the plot, but the neighbourhood, the views, the routes. We then work with architects and consultants who share our instinct for durable design: warm materials, honest proportions, layouts that function as well as they photograph. And we hold the same standard through construction, procurement and handover — because the finish is where trust is won or lost.

our-commitment.title: On time, as promised
our-commitment.body: Delivery is a commitment, not a target. Maram Group has maintained an on-schedule handover record across its portfolio by structuring each project with realistic programmes, properly resourced teams and contingency built in from the outset. When buyers choose one of our addresses, they are not just selecting a floor plan — they are entering a relationship that we intend to honour from reservation through to the moment they receive their keys.
